text:
Elaine (CS): Hey @June and team — quick intro. I'll be your CS lead for Delta Systems. Wanted to get this thread started to confirm stakeholders, measurable success criteria, and a rough 30/60/90 timeline so we can align enablement and access.

June (Delta Systems): Hi Elaine — thanks! Main stakeholders: June (PM, me), Arjun (SRE), Priya (Data), and Leila (Security). Top priorities: 1) get embeddings & reranker into search for internal docs, 2) keep P95 latency < 250ms for search flows, 3) ensure data residency controls for logs.

Marco (Solutions Eng): Adding myself for SE support — I'll own the integration guide and the first workshop. Available Mon/Wed afternoons PST.

Sam (Eng): Point of contact on infra is Arjun but CC'd me for tokenization/formatting issues. We currently route traffic via an API gateway with 200rps baseline. Any suggestions on batching thresholds?

Elaine (CS): Great — thanks. Sharing an initial 30/60/90 plan below (rough):
```
30d: access + sandbox integration, basic embeddings, one enablement workshop
60d: reranker in search E2E, perf tuning, collect first quality metrics
90d: rollout to 50% internal users, define SLOs & handoff to platform
```

Elaine (CS): Success metrics (suggested): 1) Search relevance NDCG improvement >= 0.15 vs baseline, 2) P95 latency < 250ms for search endpoints, 3) Internal adoption: 50 active users in 90d, 4) No P0 security gaps in onboarding checklist.

Redwood Onboard Bot: Playbook created -> https://redwood.app/playbooks/delta-1812345600 (private link) :white_check_mark:

June (Delta Systems): For compliance: Arjun will need VPC peering + KMS key access. Leila will own the compliance sign-off. Timeline looks fine; can you do the workshop week of Apr 12?

Marco (Solutions Eng): Apr 12 works. Proposed agenda: 1) architecture walkthrough, 2) quickstart demo, 3) hands-on integration lab (30m). I'll attach the lab repo.

Sam (Eng): Heads-up: we currently use a custom tokenizer for some docs. Will provide sample transform scripts. Also let's set a conservative default batch size (8) in staging and iterate.

Elaine (CS): Noted — Sam/Marco please add the transform script link here when ready. I'll send invites for Apr 12 and create a shared onboarding doc where we can capture open items and risks.

Marco (Solutions Eng): Major risks I see: SAML SSO delays, VPC peering window, schema mismatch for legacy docs. Mitigations: schedule SSO early, request peering window in parallel, run a data-mapping pass in week 1.

Elaine (CS): Capturing feedback is important — please ask stakeholders to complete this short form after the workshop: https://forms.redwood.com/delta-onboard-feedback (3 questions). We'll use it for improvements and for the renewal health signal.

June (Delta Systems): Thanks everyone. I'll add Arjun and Leila to the doc. One ask: can we get a short one-page runbook for failures (timeout/retry config) before we go live?

Sam (Eng): Yes, I'll draft a runbook and post it here by Apr 9.

Elaine (CS): Perfect — next steps: 1) Marco schedule workshop (Apr 12), 2) Sam share transform + runbook by Apr 9, 3) Arjun/Leila confirm peering/KMS windows, 4) team fills feedback form post-workshop. I'll follow up with calendar invites and the shared doc. :thumbsup:

June (Delta Systems): :thumbsup: sounds good. Excited to get started.

Redwood Onboard Bot: Reminder set -> workshop prep checklist due Apr 9
